domains.name: 营业配置 Store Operations
domains.objects: StorePolicy聚合根；BusinessCalendar值对象；CapabilityBinding配置；ApprovalRequest共享引用
domains.invariant: 策略按版本生效，已签核营业日不随配置改变；身份权限复用商户域

domains.name: 餐品餐牌 Food Catalog
domains.objects: DishProfile；Menu聚合根；BundleDefinition聚合根；OptionGroup聚合根；Station引用；Quote只读值对象
domains.invariant: 商品SKU价格库存归基础域；餐饮保存规则与快照；通用组合选配落地时映射迁移，不重复维护

domains.name: 就餐资源 Dining
domains.invariant: 拼桌多台账、并桌多桌；资源端口仲裁占用；同桌并发不得重复或超容量

domains.name: 点餐 Ordering
domains.invariant: 一提交一批次，加菜新批次；同SKU多口味独立源行；超时查原结果

domains.name: 制作履约 Kitchen
domains.invariant: 出纸≠出品≠上菜；撤菜重做数量可追溯；先付和后付不能重复派工

domains.name: 结账编排 Checkout
domains.invariant: 冻结范围版本，核心金额权威；收款指令不等于资金流水或已付事实

domains.name: 退餐内控 Returns
domains.invariant: 厨房处置与退款结果分轨；已做不自动回库存；当前全单退款边界保留

domains.name: 打印设备 Printing
domains.invariant: 共享打印应用拥有prn表；餐饮只生成内容，补打不制作

domains.name: 营业日与日结 Closing
domains.objects: BusinessDay聚合根；CashShift聚合根；CashEntry追加事实；CloseRun聚合根；CloseException
domains.invariant: 统计重算≠营业关账；正式签核只追加版本；现金与权威收款核销不重记

domains.name: 经营分析 Reporting
domains.invariant: 自然日与营业日标识；金额币种分离；报表可重建但签核版本不可覆盖

domains.name: 集成运行 Integration
domains.invariant: 单店单写者；重放不重复下单库存资金制作；独立服务与集成装配同合同

domains.name: 业态专项 Formats
domains.invariant: 限时消费明示；寄存与房账不伪造成新销售或已付；需外围权威确认

claimEnvelopeReview.verdict: 历史信封/远程回执审查的P2已编码修复；显式空闲与缺失信封区分、最新尝试/规范状态/responseCode一致性、claim key及UUID检查均已登记；保留owner对晚到/重复回执及FAILED→PENDING重放的原合同，不自行时钟拒绝。运行验收与历史只读审查分开记录。

risksAndRecommendations.issue: [Historical finding; current implementation has coded resolution] An empty object {} may deserialize as ClaimResult(null), so malformed missing claim field can look idle.
risksAndRecommendations.recommendation: Mark claim with @JsonProperty(required=true) and test explicit {"claim":null}, absent body, null envelope, {}, and valid claim separately; alternatively use an explicit discriminant with mutually consistent claim presence.
risksAndRecommendations.currentResolution: required claim field distinguishes explicit idle null from malformed or missing envelope; IDs bounded/nonblank, canonical UUID leaseToken and rendered payload checked

risksAndRecommendations.issue: A claim response lost after durable claim leaves SENT until expiry. A client must not interpret transport failure as proof that no delivery occurred.
risksAndRecommendations.recommendation: Keep current expiry-to-UNKNOWN and no automatic retry policy. Require hardware bridge attemptNo idempotency/reconciliation; only explicit NOT_PRINTED qualifies for ordinary retry, otherwise audited reprint with possible duplicate-paper warning.

risksAndRecommendations.issue: [Historical finding; current implementation has coded resolution] Remote acknowledge checks attemptNo presence anywhere in history, rather than verifying current/latest attempt and normalized status agreement.
risksAndRecommendations.recommendation: Validate the newest attemptNo and expected normalized result (FAILED without NOT_PRINTED becomes UNKNOWN), and match returned job/attempt status. Backend owner already fences actor, lease token and currentAttempt; do not weaken these checks.
risksAndRecommendations.currentResolution: ordered unique attempt sequences, latest attempt identity, normalized status and exact responseCode agree; FAILED->retry/PENDING duplicate receipt remains valid

risksAndRecommendations.issue: [Historical finding; current implementation has coded resolution] Non-null claim identifiers can still be blank or malformed, and leaseUntil is only checked for presence.
risksAndRecommendations.recommendation: Validate nonblank bounded job/attempt IDs and UUID token shape; consider bounded future lease checks using a supplied UTC Clock, with explicit allowed skew. DeviceNo binding is already checked.
risksAndRecommendations.currentResolution: Remote adapter does not reject past leases by local wall clock; original owner fences current attempt/token and late or duplicate receipts

resolution.claim: required claim field distinguishes explicit idle null from malformed or missing envelope; IDs bounded/nonblank, canonical UUID leaseToken and rendered payload checked
resolution.acknowledgement: ordered unique attempt sequences, latest attempt identity, normalized status and exact responseCode agree; FAILED->retry/PENDING duplicate receipt remains valid
resolution.clockBoundary: Remote adapter does not reject past leases by local wall clock; original owner fences current attempt/token and late or duplicate receipts
resolution.unchangedProtocolRisk: Lost claim response may mean SENT delivery; expiry UNKNOWN and audited reprint policy remain authoritative

boundaries: No KDS/SSE/push subscription or notification delivery proof from polling APIs
Generic report exports API078/079 and close exception carry API074 have no matching new public route
Printing and business close target paths differ and require explicit target reconciliation, rather than silently assigning exact implementation status
POSTPAY仅已登录H5/PICKUP现有身份：真实lifecycle3 reserve/acceptUnpaid，原父单保持WAIT_PAY/paidAt为空，原子单履约可推进；不能称已收款。
FOOD ACCEPTED、额度consume及DINING_ORDER_ACCEPTED出站事实同本域事务；物理出纸、通知推送与财务验收必须由各owner真回执另证。
原料执行只接受真实冻结叶子计划；缺少既有配方权威计划时保留BLOCKED，不能通过成品/原料双扣或虚构成本完成。
日结/报表仅输出已核实源事实与完整性状态，财务未闭合不补造SIGNED/资金成功；异步导出和异常结转目标仍未交付。
新就座锁定原票后，在同一food primary事务内调用CheckService.openQueuedCheck，仅限内部Java调用，不能经HTTP/remote；原开台、SEATED、queue动作与outbox同提交。冲突整体回滚，原CALLED票可重选；不把永久SEATING作为新流程。
旧SEATING仅兼容原冻结命令/OPEN_CHECK原键回执恢复；未知保持未知，不创建替代开台。新seat走同primary原子事务。
首次打印身份不包含客户端Idempotency-Key；ORDER/KITCHEN/RETURN按原单据+scene/station固定，PREBILL按原文档snapshot版本；换key同内容不新增首次任务。额外纸张必须走关联原任务+原因+操作人的审计reprint；UNKNOWN禁止普通retry。
制作耗用列表API153已编码真实scope-bound SQL分页/COUNT；共享PageData<long page/size>及ConsumptionVO与目标模型差异仍显式登记；查询不触发原料出库、恢复或补造成本。
DINING_ORDER_ACCEPTED出站处理先幂等持久化原MAKE票，再按已配置ORDER/KITCHEN纸张route入队；无route不造任务。claim/ACK才提供设备领取与回执，自动入队不代表已出纸。
KDS默认未指定batchNo时仅返回ACCEPTED批次的未CLOSED票和非SERVED/VOIDED任务；显式batchNo可查历史，保留原MAKE/REMAKE及原票关系；轮询不等于实时推送。
